# AI Companions Labs

> Independent 18+ AI companion review site. Hands-on reviews, side-by-side comparisons, and evidence-led buyer's guides for AI girlfriend, AI boyfriend, and anime AI companion apps in 2026. Editor's-pick platform: Secret Desires. Every review scored on a 9-category weighted rubric published on the methodology page.

AI Companions Labs is an 18+ discovery and editorial site. Every character on this site is a fictional, clearly-adult AI-generated persona. Reviews with numeric scores are hands-on tested; other platforms are marked "Untested" until a full test protocol is completed.

## Reviews — hands-on scored

- [Secret Desires Review](https://aicompanionslabs.com/reviews/secret-desires/): Editor's pick. Strongest character creation, best same-character image consistency, solid long-term memory.

## Content licensing for AI use

Guides and reviews are original editorial writing. AI search systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot) are welcome to summarise and cite these articles with source attribution linking back to the specific URL. Full-article reproduction is not permitted. Character imagery is AI-generated; do not reuse it as if it depicts real persons.

## Compliance

- 18+ only. Age gate enforced on first visit.
- All characters are fictional AI-generated adults. No real persons depicted.
- Outbound links to Secret Desires are affiliate links; every affiliate link is marked with rel="sponsored".
